sources.title: PrunaAI/P-H3-Image-Comfy · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository holds the ComfyUI files for P-H3-Image, an image model for text-to-image generation and image editing based on MiniMax-H3. It renders 8-megapixel images in 8 steps without CFG and edits with up to 8 input images. Every component comes in bf16 and in ComfyUI's native int8 and 4-bit ...

sources.title: P-H3-Image in ComfyUI: 8-Step Text to Image and Edit
sources.snippet: Run P-H3-Image in ComfyUI to render 8 MP photoreal images in 8 steps without CFG, and to edit photos with a source image plus up to eight reference images. P-H3-Image is Pruna AI’s open-weights image model built on MiniMax H3. It handles two tasks in one checkpoint: text-to-image generation and image editing.
